command.name: ffmpeg

arguments.name: outfile
arguments.description: Output file URL. Options preceding an output file apply to that file.

options.name: -sources
options.description: list sources of the input device

options.name: -sinks
options.description: list sinks of the output device

options.name: -print_graphs
options.description: print execution graph data to stderr

options.name: -print_graphs_file
options.description: write execution graph data to the specified file

options.name: -print_graphs_format
options.description: set the output printing format (available formats are: default, compact, csv, flat, ini, json, xml, mermaid, mermaidhtml)

options.name: -max_alloc
options.description: set maximum size of a single allocated block

options.name: -recast_media
options.description: allow recasting stream type in order to force a decoder of different media type

options.name: -stdin
options.description: enable or disable interaction on standard input

options.name: -timelimit
options.description: set max runtime in seconds in CPU user time

options.name: -hex
options.description: when dumping packets, also dump the payload

options.name: -start_at_zero
options.description: shift input timestamps to start at 0 when using copyts

options.name: -copytb
options.description: copy input stream time base when stream copying

options.name: -abort_on
options.description: abort on the specified condition flags

options.name: -filter_buffered_frames
options.description: maximum number of buffered frames in a filter graph

options.name: -stats_period
options.description: set the period at which ffmpeg updates stats and -progress output

options.name: -max_error_rate
options.description: ratio of decoding errors (0.0: no errors, 1.0: 100% errors) above which ffmpeg returns an error instead of success.

options.name: -vstats
options.description: dump video coding statistics to file

options.name: -vstats_file
options.description: dump video coding statistics to file

options.name: -vstats_version
options.description: Version of the vstats format to use.

options.name: -sdp_file
options.description: specify a file in which to print sdp information

options.name: -filter_hw_device
options.description: set hardware device used when filtering

options.name: -vsync
options.description: set video sync method globally; deprecated, use -fps_mode

options.name: -to
options.description: stop transcoding after specified time is reached

options.name: -thread_queue_size
options.description: set the maximum number of queued packets from the demuxer

options.name: -sseof
options.description: set the start time offset relative to EOF

options.name: -isync
options.description: Indicate the input index for sync reference

options.name: -re
options.description: read input at native frame rate; equivalent to -readrate 1

options.name: -readrate_initial_burst
options.description: The initial amount of input to burst read before imposing any readrate

options.name: -readrate_catchup
options.description: Temporary readrate used to catch up if an input lags behind the specified readrate

options.name: -dump_attachment
options.description: extract an attachment into a file

options.name: -stream_loop
options.description: set number of times input stream shall be looped

options.name: -find_stream_info
options.description: read and decode the streams to fill missing information with heuristics

options.name: -map_metadata
options.description: set metadata information of outfile from infile

options.name: -fs
options.description: set the limit file size in bytes

options.name: -timestamp
options.description: set the recording timestamp ('now' to set the current time)

options.name: -stream_group
options.description: add stream group with specified streams and group type-specific arguments

options.name: -dframes
options.description: set the number of data frames to output

options.name: -target
options.description: specify target file type ("vcd", "svcd", "dvd", "dv" or "dv50" with optional prefixes "pal-", "ntsc-" or "film-")

options.name: -shortest_buf_duration
options.description: maximum buffering duration (in seconds) for the -shortest option

options.name: -attach
options.description: add an attachment to the output file

options.name: -fpre
options.description: set options from indicated preset file

options.name: -c
options.description: select encoder/decoder ('copy' to copy stream without reencoding)

options.name: -copypriorss
options.description: copy or discard frames before start time

options.name: -frames
options.description: set the number of frames to output

options.name: -reinit_filter
options.description: reinit filtergraph on input parameter changes

options.name: -drop_changed
options.description: drop frame instead of reiniting filtergraph on input parameter changes

options.name: -bits_per_raw_sample
options.description: set the number of bits per raw sample

options.name: -stats_enc_pre_fmt
options.description: format of the stats written with -stats_enc_pre

options.name: -stats_enc_post_fmt
options.description: format of the stats written with -stats_enc_post

options.name: -stats_mux_pre_fmt
options.description: format of the stats written with -stats_mux_pre

options.name: -time_base
options.description: set the desired time base hint for output stream (1:24, 1:48000 or 0.04166, 2.0833e-5)

options.name: -enc_time_base
options.description: set the desired time base for the encoder (1:24, 1:48000 or 0.04166, 2.0833e-5). two special values are defined - 0 = use frame rate (video) or sample rate (audio),-1 = match source time base

options.name: -bsf
options.description: A comma-separated list of bitstream filters

options.name: -max_muxing_queue_size
options.description: maximum number of packets that can be buffered while waiting for all streams to initialize

options.name: -muxing_queue_data_threshold
options.description: set the threshold after which max_muxing_queue_size is taken into account

options.name: -r
options.description: override input framerate/convert to given output framerate (Hz value, fraction or abbreviation)

options.name: -vcodec
options.description: alias for -c:v (select encoder/decoder for video streams)

options.name: -vf
options.description: alias for -filter:v (apply filters to video streams)

options.name: -vframes
options.description: set the number of video frames to output

options.name: -fpsmax
options.description: set max frame rate (Hz value, fraction or abbreviation)

options.name: -display_rotation
options.description: set pure counter-clockwise rotation in degrees for stream(s)

options.name: -display_hflip
options.description: set display horizontal flip for stream(s) (overrides any display rotation if it is not set)

options.name: -display_vflip
options.description: set display vertical flip for stream(s) (overrides any display rotation if it is not set)

options.name: -rc_override
options.description: rate control override for specific intervals

options.name: -passlogfile
options.description: select two pass log file name prefix

options.name: -fps_mode
options.description: set framerate mode for matching video streams; overrides vsync

options.name: -force_fps
options.description: force the selected framerate, disable the best supported framerate selection

options.name: -streamid
options.description: set the value of an outfile streamid

options.name: -force_key_frames
options.description: force key frames at specified timestamps

options.name: -hwaccel_device
options.description: select a device for HW acceleration

options.name: -hwaccel_output_format
options.description: select output format used with HW accelerated decoding

options.name: -autoscale
options.description: automatically insert a scale filter at the end of the filter graph

options.name: -fix_sub_duration_heartbeat
options.description: set this video output stream to be a heartbeat stream for fix_sub_duration, according to which subtitles should be split at random access points

options.name: -vpre
options.description: set the video options to the indicated preset

options.name: -top
options.description: deprecated, use the setfield video filter

options.name: -acodec
options.description: alias for -c:a (select encoder/decoder for audio streams)

options.name: -ab

options.name: -aframes
